name: mern-blog
description: Root scripts for local full-stack development

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/vite_blog"
scripts.build:frontend: npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend/vite_blog && npm run build --prefix frontend/vite_blog && node scripts/publish-frontend.mjs
scripts.build:render: npm run build:frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
